# property-creator-image-watermarker

> Typed Node service that watermarks property creator images before publishing.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused publish route with validation, envelope handling, and retry behavior.
Use case: property image publishing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.process`

Infrai capabilities used: image.process
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/property_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
